issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'בֵּית חוֹרוֹן' (Beth-horon), but the Chinese renders it as '戶崙' (Hulun), which is a different name. The correct transliteration should be '伯和崙' (Beth-horon).
The Hebrew 'קִרְיַת בַּעַל' (Kiriath-baal) is rendered as '巴力基列' (Baal-gilead), which swaps the order and changes the name. It should be '基列巴力' (Kiriath-baal) or '巴力城' (city of Baal).
The Hebrew 'קִרְיַת יְעָרִים' (Kiriath-jearim) is rendered as '基列亞琳' (Gilead-arim), which is a different name. It should be '基列耶琳' (Kiriath-jearim).

The Hebrew 'עִיר בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה' (city of the sons of Judah) is rendered as '猶大兒子的城' (city of Judah's sons), which is acceptable, but the phrase 'בְּנֵי יְהוּדָה' is a construct chain meaning 'sons of Judah', and the Chinese '猶大兒子' is close, so this is not a major issue. However, the overall rendering of the verse has multiple name errors.
